name: Vercel React Best Practices
description: React and Next.js performance optimization guidelines from Vercel Engineering. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring React/Next.js code.
brief:
Skill: VERCEL REACT BEST PRACTICES. Write performant React/Next.js code.
- Use Server Components by default; Client Components only when needed (interactivity, hooks, browser APIs).
- Optimize data fetching: parallel where possible, use Suspense boundaries, avoid waterfalls.
- Use `next/image` for automatic optimization; specify width/height to prevent layout shift.
- Minimize bundle size: dynamic imports for heavy components, tree-shake dependencies.
- Prefer CSS Modules or Tailwind over CSS-in-JS for zero-runtime styling.
- Use `useMemo`/`useCallback` only for measured hotspots - profile first.
- Enable React Compiler (when stable) for automatic memoization.
- Test with real-world data volumes, not toy datasets.
